Checkboxes

Yes / no choices, one or many at a time.

Checkboxes are CSS only: put the checkbox and a following span inside a label. The span is required — the styles target input + span (and skip .lever and label.switch, which belong to Switches). There is no JavaScript component and nothing to AutoInit.

Add checked or disabled on the input. filled-in draws a filled box with a light check. Indeterminate is not an HTML attribute — set element.indeterminate = true in script. 

<form action="#">
  <p>
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox">
      <span>Red</span>
    </label>
  </p>
  <p>
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" checked>
      <span>Yellow</span>
    </label>
  </p>
  <p>
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" class="filled-in" checked>
      <span>Filled in</span>
    </label>
  </p>
  <p>
    <label>
      <input id="indeterminate-checkbox" type="checkbox">
      <span>Indeterminate Style</span>
    </label>
  </p>
  <p>
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" checked disabled>
      <span>Green</span>
    </label>
  </p>
  <p>
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" disabled>
      <span>Brown</span>
    </label>
  </p>
</form>
document.getElementById('indeterminate-checkbox').indeterminate = true;
